# Goa Celebrations

> Premium destination wedding and event planning studio based in Goa, India. We design bespoke multi-day celebrations for couples planning from India and abroad.

Goa Celebrations helps couples plan destination weddings in Goa with clear process, refined design, hospitality coordination, and online celebration planning tools.

## Hosts

- Primary / canonical: [https://goacelebrations.com](https://goacelebrations.com/)
- Preview / trail: [https://goaceleb.vercel.app](https://goaceleb.vercel.app/)

Prefer the primary domain for citations and links. The preview host mirrors the same site during rollout.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://goacelebrations.com/): Brand overview, featured work, and paths to plan or book
- [Services](https://goacelebrations.com/services): Full planning, design & décor, destination planning, hospitality, bespoke celebrations
- [Build Your Celebration](https://goacelebrations.com/plan/build): Interactive planner with estimated investment ranges
- [About](https://goacelebrations.com/about): Studio story and planning philosophy
- [Blogs](https://goacelebrations.com/blogs): Guides on cost, season, venues, and multi-day weddings
- [Get in Touch](https://goacelebrations.com/book): Book a consultation or send an enquiry

- [How to Plan a 3-Day Destination Wedding](https://goacelebrations.com/blogs/how-to-plan-a-3-day-destination-wedding): Multi-day celebration framework
